scope: Independent substantive review of the 55-authority CFEL specification candidate: bindings, VALUES, and counts. Metadata grammar migration is intentionally excluded as phase 2.

checks.evidence: CA-R-2904 defines VALUES as actual direct value occurrences only; CA-R-2585 uses COUNT(VALUES(p)) and COUNT(DISTINCT VALUES(p)), retaining duplicates, known absence, malformed/unresolved errors, Format equality, and per-bearer scope. CA-R-2566 preserves same-instance filters, short-circuit/error behavior, scalar-only MAX, ordering, and empty/incompatible/non-orderable errors. Current UNIQUE and DETERMINES retain their single resolved tuple-value-per-selected-instance/state semantics without a blind VALUES rewrite.

CA-R-2804 and CA-R-2248 treat <Workflow Run> OR <Step Run> as one union participant/domain and apply cardinality once over the full union. Named and anonymous typed bindings select existing instances only; repeated named references retain identity and do not create facts.

CA-R-2487 defines IF true/false behavior and preserves unresolved-condition errors; its binding is scoped to the condition and matching THEN body. CA-R-2778 makes FOR EACH a typed, explicitly declared participant with a scoped parenthesized body, universal truth over matching instances, and no nonempty-selection requirement.

CA-R-2248 and CA-R-2487 distinguish primitive/object Formats from model-instance selection. CA-R-2243 and CA-R-2487 preserve separate occurrence, direct-value, immediate-name, and recursive-name counts; a named applicable Property has at most one occurrence per corresponding bearer, while a structural parent may have nonempty child structure as its value. No candidate introduces <Node.**> as a fake kind/domain.

CA-R-2816 and the R2487 overview agree that inherited HAV alternatives combine by OR, inherited HVC restrictions by AND, and absent HAV is true. R2487 preserves only double-quote/backslash escapes, rejects every other or incomplete escape, and requires parentheses for mixed AND/OR; CA-R-2820/2821 agree.

integrity.review_not_hash_only: Each PASS above is based on the cited prospective content and cross-authority semantics.

limitations: Existing Header Subject metadata that still uses old grammar is an intentional coordinated phase-2 migration, not a substantive CFEL contract failure here.
PASS does not establish Current adoption, parser/runtime implementation, or tests.
